method: monthly walk-forward RAPM (net xG/60, ridge, alpha by 5-fold CV at the first cutoff) on raw xG; tonight = dressed skaters, baseline = 18 most-used over the previous 20 games; base = walk-forward game-model probability; weight fitted on one half, tested on the other
coverage_gate: >= 14 of 18 skaters rated on both sides
decision: lineup term does not improve held-out log loss in both halves: weight = 0
